items.criterion: A refund at or below the acting member's ceiling moves the store balance by exactly that amount.
items.judgment: Read the available balance before and after, and compare the difference with the refunded amount.

items.criterion: The refunded order advances its financial status and carries a refund entry naming its actor.
items.judgment: Read the order detail and its timeline after the refund.

items.criterion: A refund above the ceiling returns a pending approval request naming the required permission and an expiry.
items.judgment: Post the refund and read the returned object's state, action type, amount, required permission and expiry.

items.criterion: A pending request has written no ledger entry and has left the order paid.
items.judgment: Read the balance and the order before and after the wait, and read the persisted request row.

items.criterion: The requester is denied a decision on their own request and the request stays pending.
items.judgment: Post a decision from the requester's session and read the request state afterwards.

items.criterion: One approval executes the refund once, and a repeated approval executes nothing further.
items.judgment: Approve twice under one key and compare the balance after each decision.

items.criterion: The approved order reads refunded and the decided request names its decider.
items.judgment: Read the order detail and the decided request.

items.criterion: A replayed refund under one idempotency key returns the first result and moves nothing further.
items.judgment: Post the same key twice and compare the returned identifiers and the balance.

items.criterion: A refund larger than the captured amount is refused and the order row is untouched.
items.judgment: Post an oversized refund and read the order afterwards.

items.criterion: A negative refund amount is refused as a client error.
items.judgment: Post a refund of minus one and read the status.

items.criterion: An unrecognised field in a refund body is refused rather than ignored.
items.judgment: Post a body carrying a misspelled field and read the status.

items.criterion: A decimal money amount is refused rather than coerced into minor units.
items.judgment: Post a fractional amount and read the status.

items.criterion: An anonymous caller reaches no store data.
items.judgment: Request the order index without a session and read the status.

items.criterion: A member of one store reaches nothing belonging to another store.
items.judgment: Request a foreign order by identifier and read the other store's index.

items.criterion: Naming another store in a request widens nothing the session may read.
items.judgment: Request the order index with a foreign store parameter and read what comes back.

items.criterion: The store list exposes only the stores the session's person is a member of.
items.judgment: Read the store list from a single-membership session.

items.criterion: A stock adjustment outside the acting member's locations is denied and the level is unchanged.
items.judgment: Post an adjustment from a session without the permission and read the level afterwards.

items.criterion: No inventory level reports an available quantity above on hand minus committed minus reserved.
items.judgment: Read every level and compare the reported available quantity with the stored columns.

items.criterion: A permitted stock adjustment moves the level by its delta and names its movement reason.
items.judgment: Post an adjustment of one and read the level and the response.

items.criterion: Two simultaneous purchases of the last unit produce exactly one success.
items.judgment: Complete two checkouts for the same single unit at once and count the successes.

items.criterion: The seeded orders carry the totals the brief pins.
items.judgment: Read the order index and compare each total with the pinned value.

items.criterion: Financial status and fulfilment status are separate fields on every order.
items.judgment: Read the order index and check both fields are present and independent.

items.criterion: The balance surface reports an integer in minor units and reconciles with the refunded orders.
items.judgment: Read the balance and the refunded orders together.

items.criterion: Every approval request exposes its requester, its amount, its required permission and its expiry.
items.judgment: Read the approval index and check each field is present.

items.criterion: The readiness probe answers on the contracted path.
items.judgment: Request the readiness path and read the status.

items.criterion: The order index is returned as a top-level array.
items.judgment: Read the order index payload and check its outermost type.

items.criterion: An unknown storefront address answers not found inside the product's own chrome with a way back.
items.judgment: Request an unknown address and read the status and the markup.

items.criterion: Every public route carries its own title and its own description.
items.judgment: Read each public route and compare the declared titles and descriptions.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists every public route and the robots file names the sitemap.
items.judgment: Read both files and compare the sitemap against the route set.

items.criterion: Every internal link on every public route resolves.
items.judgment: Follow each internal link found on the public routes and read the statuses.

items.criterion: The privacy page and the terms page are reachable from the footer of the country home.
items.judgment: Request both routes and read the country home's markup for links to them.

items.criterion: Both seeded locations are present in the stock surface under the names the brief pins.
items.judgment: Read the inventory surface and look for both location names.

items.criterion: The refund composer opens as a panel over the order it refunds, so the order's own totals stay on screen beside the amount field.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at the order detail surface with the refund action open.

items.criterion: Submitting a refund above the ceiling lands on a full-page confirmation naming the request, its amount and the permission required to decide it.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at what the admin shows after an above-ceiling refund is submitted.

items.criterion: The approval queue is a dense list where each row carries its requester, its amount, its reason and its expiry without opening the row.
items.judgment: Judged by looking at the approval queue surface.

items.criterion: Every interactive control in the admin shell carries a visible focus ring when reached by keyboard.
items.judgment: Judged by moving through the admin shell with the keyboard alone.
